tools.name: findall_runs-v1

You can get the run result snapshot using the GET /v1beta/findall/runs/{findall_id}/result endpoint. You can track the progress of the run by: - Polling the status using the GET /v1beta/findall/runs/{findall_id} endpoint, - Subscribing to real-time updates via the /v1beta/findall/runs/{findall_id}/events endpoint, - Or specifying a webhook with relevant event types during run creation to receive notifications. Required: entity_type, generator, match_conditions, match_limit, objective. Optional: exclude_list, metadata, webhook.

params.name: entity_type
params.description: Type of the entity for the FindAll run.

params.name: exclude_list
params.description: List of entity names/IDs to exclude from results. At most 10,000 entries are allowed.

params.name: generator
params.description: Generator for the FindAll run. One of base, core, pro, preview.

params.name: match_conditions
params.description: List of match conditions for the FindAll run.

params.name: match_limit
params.description: Maximum number of matches to find for this FindAll run. Must be between 5 and 1000 (inclusive). May return fewer results.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Metadata for the FindAll run.

params.name: objective
params.description: Natural language objective of the FindAll run.

params.name: webhook
params.description: Webhook for the FindAll run.

tools.name: monitors_create
tools.description: Create a monitor. Monitors run on a fixed frequency to detect material changes in web content. Set `type=event_stream` to monitor a search query, or `type=snapshot` to monitor a specific task run's output. The monitor runs once immediately at creation, then continues on the configured schedule. Required: frequency, settings, type. Optional: metadata, processor (default: lite), webhook. Returns the new MonitorResponse.

params.name: frequency
params.description: Frequency of the monitor. Format: '<number><unit>' where unit is 'h' (hours), 'd' (days), or 'w' (weeks). Must be between 1h and 30d (inclusive).

params.name: metadata
params.description: User-provided metadata stored with the monitor and echoed back in webhook notifications and GET responses, so you can map events to objects in your application. Keys: max 16 chars; values: max 512 chars.

params.name: processor
params.description: Processor to use for the monitor. `lite` is faster and cheaper; `base` performs more thorough analysis at higher cost and latency. Defaults to `lite`.

params.name: settings
params.description: Type-specific settings for the monitor. The expected shape is determined by the root `type` field: pass `MonitorEventStreamSettings` when `type` is `event_stream`, and `MonitorSnapshotSettings` when `type` is `snapshot`.

params.name: type
params.description: Type of monitor to create. `event_stream` monitors a search query for material changes; `snapshot` monitors a specific task run's output. Determines the expected shape of `settings`.

params.name: webhook
params.description: Webhook to receive notifications about the monitor's execution.

tools.name: monitors_list
tools.description: List monitors ordered by creation time, newest first. Monitors are sorted by `created_at` descending. `limit` defaults to 100. Use `next_cursor` from the response and pass it as `cursor` to fetch the next page. Pagination ends when `next_cursor` is absent. By default only `active` monitors are returned. Pass `status=cancelled` or both values to include cancelled monitors. The legacy Monitor API (`/v1alpha/monitors` endpoints) is documented under the `Monitor (Alpha)` tag. Optional: cursor, limit, type (plus 1 more). Returns array of MonitorResponse.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination token from `next_cursor` in a previous response. Omit to start from the most recently created monitor.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of monitors to return. Defaults to 100. Between 1 and 10000.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by monitor type. Pass multiple times to filter by multiple values. Omit to return all types.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by monitor status. Pass multiple times to filter by multiple values. Defaults to `active` only.

tools.name: monitors_retrieve
tools.description: Retrieve a monitor. Retrieves a specific monitor by `monitor_id`. Returns the monitor configuration including status, frequency, query, and webhook settings. Required: monitor_id.

params.name: monitor_id
params.description: Monitor id

tools.name: monitors_cancel_monitor
tools.description: Cancel a monitor. Permanently stops the monitor from running. Cancellation is irreversible — create a new monitor to resume monitoring. Cancelling an already-cancelled monitor is a no-op. Required: monitor_id. Returns the new MonitorResponse.

params.name: monitor_id
params.description: Monitor id

tools.name: monitors_events_list-monitor
tools.description: List events for a monitor, newest first. Pass `event_group_id` to narrow results to a single execution. Otherwise returns all executions newest-first; use `next_cursor` to paginate. Set `include_completions=true` to also include no-change executions. Required: monitor_id. Optional: event_group_id, cursor, limit (plus 1 more).

params.name: monitor_id
params.description: Monitor id

params.name: event_group_id
params.description: Filter to a single execution. Values come from `event_group_id` in webhook events and listed events. Pagination params are ignored when set.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pass `next_cursor` from a previous response to retrieve more events.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of events to return. Defaults to 20. Between 1 and 100.

params.name: include_completions
params.description: When true, include completion events for executions that ran but detected no material changes. Useful for auditing execution history.

tools.name: monitors_trigger_monitor-run
tools.description: Trigger an immediate monitor run. Enqueues a one-off execution of the monitor outside its normal schedule. The monitor's regular schedule is not affected. An event is only emitted if the execution detects a material change. Cancelled monitors cannot be triggered. Required: monitor_id.

params.name: monitor_id
params.description: Monitor id

tools.name: monitors_update_monitor
tools.description: Update a monitor. Only fields explicitly included in the request body are changed. Pass `null` for `webhook` or `metadata` to clear those fields. Pass `type` and `settings` to update type-specific settings on an `event_stream` monitor. At least one field must be provided. Cancelled monitors cannot be updated. Required: monitor_id. Optional: frequency, metadata, settings (plus 2 more). Returns the new MonitorResponse.

params.name: monitor_id
params.description: Monitor id

params.name: frequency
params.description: Frequency of the monitor. Format: '<number><unit>' where unit is 'h' (hours), 'd' (days), or 'w' (weeks). Must be between 1h and 30d (inclusive).

params.name: metadata
params.description: User-provided metadata stored with the monitor and echoed back in webhook notifications and GET responses, so you can map events to objects in your application. Keys: max 16 chars; values: max 512 chars.

params.name: settings
params.description: Type-specific settings to update. Only valid when `type` is `event_stream`. Pass `settings.query` to update the prompt, or `null` for `settings.advanced_settings` to clear it.

params.name: type
params.description: Type of the monitor being updated. Required when `settings` is provided; must be `event_stream` (snapshot monitors have no updatable type-specific settings).

params.name: webhook
params.description: Webhook to receive notifications about the monitor's execution.

tools.name: websearch_search
tools.description: Searches the web. The legacy Search API reference (`/v1beta/search` endpoint) is available [here](https://docs.parallel.ai/api-reference/legacy/search-beta/search), and migration guide is [here](https://docs.parallel.ai/search/search-migration-guide). Required: search_queries. Optional: advanced_settings, client_model, max_chars_total (plus 3 more). Returns array of V1WebSearchResult.

params.name: advanced_settings
params.description: Advanced configuration for source policy, fetch policy, and excerpt settings. May impact result quality and latency unless used carefully. When omitted, excerpts are enabled by default.

params.name: client_model
params.description: The model generating this request and consuming the results. Enables optimizations and tailors default settings for the model's capabilities.

params.name: max_chars_total
params.description: Upper bound on total characters across excerpts from all results.

params.name: mode
params.description: Search mode preset: supported values are `turbo`, `basic`, and `advanced`. Turbo mode is optimized for the fastest responses. Basic mode offers low latency and works best with 2-3 high-quality search_queries. Advanced mode provides higher quality with more advanced retrieval and compression. Defaults to `advanced` when omitted.

params.name: objective
params.description: Natural-language description of the underlying question or goal driving the search. Used together with search_queries to focus results on the most relevant content. Should be self-contained with enough context to understand the intent of the search.

params.name: search_queries
params.description: Concise keyword search queries, 3-6 words each. At least one query is required, provide 2-3 for best results. Used together with objective to focus results on the most relevant content.

params.name: session_id
params.description: Session identifier to track calls across separate search and extract calls, to be used as part of a larger task. Specifying it may give better contextual results for subsequent API calls.
